shared_elements: an animal figure in profile (low relief on the pillar in A; horses/animals in B)
justification: A shows an excavated architectural setting of plain upright pillars and a shaped stone block, with at most a single small animal relief in profile on one pillar; B shows dense, registered friezes of processional standing human figures with weapons and headgear, plus chariots and draft animals. Beyond both being relief-bearing stonework with an animal in profile somewhere, there is no shared motif, relationship, or arrangement: A is essentially unornamented and non-figural, B is a narrative multi-register procession.
